Excellent service and, most importantly, care and love for our pets, because pets are love and family 🥰♥️, thank you to the entire Vet Central Mandaqui team,

Wonderful service, I have nothing to complain about, they always treat my dog ​​with affection and attention, I highly recommend them... I only have gratitude for each one of them.

Terrible experience.

I took my elderly dog ​​to the clinic due to intense itching and skin lesions, expecting careful and professional care. However, the experience was extremely disappointing.

During the consultation, I explained the situation, but the veterinarian barely examined my dog. He didn't properly assess the lesions, didn't check basic vital signs like temperature and heart rate, and didn't ask about her health history, including the kidney problems she already had. Even so, without proper investigation, he concluded it was just an allergic reaction and prescribed oral and injectable medications, including one very expensive one.

Furthermore, the prescribed ointment worsened the symptoms, which led me to return to the clinic seeking guidance. To my surprise, upon returning, I was informed that there was nothing they could do.

Faced with the situation, I sought treatment at another clinic, where I was informed that the prescribed medications needed to be reevaluated, considering the symptoms presented and my dog's medical history, especially her advanced age and kidney problems.

What bothered me most was the lack of care and, above all, attention during the evaluation, the absence of a proper investigation before prescribing, and the lack of support when her condition worsened. I also had a negative impression of the clinic's hygiene and facilities for clinical care.

We are talking about an elderly animal, which requires extra attention and a thorough evaluation before receiving any medication. I expected, at the very least, responsible, careful treatment that was compatible with her needs.

I do not recommend the clinic!!

Excellent review and friendly staff!!

I have a plan and they recommended this place to me.

Look, I don't know if the person who assisted me is unhappy with the company, but I received terrible service, and she even advised me to file a complaint.
When we look for a place like this, especially when our pet is sick, we expect to find care, but what I found was total disrespect.

I hope that those in charge will keep an eye on the service provided by their employees, because mistreating customers and especially animals is regrettable.

Unfortunately, my experience with the clinic was extremely negative. From the beginning, I had headaches and faced unpleasant situations during my dog's treatment.

In addition to the dissatisfaction with the experience, I felt mistreated and disrespected, something unacceptable in an establishment that should value the care, empathy, and well-being of animals and their owners.

Those seeking veterinary care expect professionalism, respect, transparency, and above all, care for their animal. Unfortunately, that was not the experience I had.

It is not enough to offer a veterinary service; it is necessary to have responsibility, respect, and empathy for the animals and the people who entrust their care to the clinic.

Given what I experienced, I would not return and would not recommend the establishment.

VetCentral has been my trusted clinic for years! When my cat had FIP (which is very difficult to diagnose), they treated her promptly and arrived at a diagnosis very quickly, which makes all the difference. Since then, we've had all our routine procedures and consultations done with them. The team is highly skilled; the veterinarians are extremely professional and qualified, didactic, and always available. This week I had my cat spayed with them and I was very apprehensive, given her history of FIP, but they did all the necessary pre-operative exams, follow-ups, etc. In addition, they have a surgical team that takes every procedure very seriously, even in "simpler" cases like spaying. Her spaying was attended by the surgeon, assistant, and anesthesiologist (and we know that many clinics fail to have a multidisciplinary surgical team).

I highly recommend both the Mandaqui and Santana locations! I frequent both and they are equally professional.

I've always taken my pets, cats, to this clinic since I got the Pet Love plan. Although the initial appointments were satisfactory, I mean in relation to the veterinary medical treatment. Today, just taking my kitten for her second dose of necessary vaccines, I was surprised by an unnecessary exam; the kitten was only there for vaccination. The doctor in question, Ana, said that she could do this blood count exam to speed up the process for the spaying, which would be scheduled later. She said that such an exam would not be covered (co-payment) by Pet Love. She advised me to contact the company through the app. I didn't understand. The exam is part of the plan, she did the exam. She also asked for a rapid FeLV test, which she said was necessary for spaying. This exam is also covered by Pet Love. When paying for the procedures, I saw that only the vaccine had the discount from the plan, 25 reais.

I paid 255 reais for the procedures that should have been discounted by the plan. Upon leaving, I still asked the doctor why the exam was done, since I wasn't going to spay the cat before her first heat, and that, according to her own advice, it would be better to wait.
In short, Vet Central seems to have become just a company with financial interests, taking your money without even clarifying anything. An unnecessary exam, and a FeLV rapid test charged without a discount from the Pet Love plan.
I have already contacted Pet Love requesting reimbursement for the abusive amounts charged.

After more than a month of me asking for the results, they don't know what happened, they don't even know who the patient is, and they send old results. They ask me to redo the test, and again the same ordeal. I've been asking for the results for over a month, they don't get back to me, they don't answer me, and I can't get my dog's treatment. Yesterday, December 28th, I took my pet to get her V10 vaccine updated before traveling. Before going, I checked via WhatsApp to see if an appointment was necessary. I was assisted by Daiane, who informed me it was on a first-come, first-served basis. Upon arrival, it was great because there were available slots; there were no other appointments. We arrived and were immediately attended to, followed by the consultation. Dr. Lucas saw us, administered the vaccine (she felt absolutely nothing, it was very quick!), gave me instructions regarding deworming and flea treatment, and we arranged to administer the rabies vaccine later. He also weighed her and documented everything, even informing me that Vet Central also has neurology specialists. I loved the service, the location, the reception, and the cleanliness. I only ask the owner of the unit to assess the air conditioning equipment, which clearly needs a refrigerant recharge, because even though the unit is small, it was extremely stuffy and inappropriate for a veterinary environment. Furthermore, my experience was definitely good because of the prompt service from everyone, as this meant I didn't have to stay there for very long, since it was very stuffy.

It wasn't the first time we needed to go to Vet Central, but it was certainly the last. I will never return to that clinic.

On Friday (December 5, 2025), my brother took Bacon to the clinic because we noticed he was drinking a lot of water, urinating excessively, and had discharge from his eyes and nose.

During the consultation, the veterinarian stated that this excessive water intake and large amount of urine were the result of "weak kidneys due to age." Note: Bacon is an 8-year-old Yorkshire Terrier, extremely active and cheerful.

They did an X-ray—an exam they never allow owners to attend—collected blood, and released us with only a syrup and two vitamin supplements.

Since starting the prescribed syrup, Bacon has drastically worsened. When I received the test results, I contacted the veterinarian via WhatsApp, and he informed me that the exam indicated diabetes and a possible syndrome that "would be investigated."

At the veterinarian's request, we returned on December 9th. He prescribed more medication—just as expensive as the first—and even referred us to an endocrinologist and ordered new tests. Only in this second consultation did he diagnose conjunctivitis and the flu, problems we had already pointed out in the first consultation and which were completely ignored.

We followed the treatment at home, trusting the prescription. However, in the early morning of December 11th, Bacon became extremely ill, with severe vomiting and extreme weakness.

Completely disillusioned with the care at Vet Central, I rushed Bacon to an emergency veterinary hospital. And that's when we received the worst news: my dog ​​was in a very serious diabetic crisis, aggravated by a lack of proper treatment.

The tests done at Vet Central already indicated diabetes, but they were ignored. And, to top it all off, the doctor himself prescribed a syrup rich in glucose—a substance that almost killed my dog.

Bacon arrived at the hospital extremely debilitated, practically without strength. Today he is hospitalized receiving insulin via infusion pump, in addition to treatment for bronchitis, a direct consequence of the flu that was also ignored by Vet Central.

I sincerely hope that the current treatment is effective and that Bacon recovers fully, without any injury. The negligence and lack of attention from Vet Central may have caused very serious damage, including neurological damage.

Now, our focus is on Bacon's recovery.

But let me make it clear: the matter is far from over.
